'''2016 European Championship Day 3 Jon Benkert Holtet LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jon Benkert Holtet]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jon Benkert Holtet]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125837/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-european-championships.html Internet Archive]
